info.name: Flying Angels - Complete backend verification
info.description:
Standalone backend functional verification with Admin sign-in. Select an environment with baseUrl, email and password, keep cookies enabled, and run every folder in order against disposable data. Folder 00 detects authentication mode, fetches CSRF, signs in as Admin and refreshes CSRF. Invalid credentials or a non-Admin login stop the run before CRUD. Only an explicitly authentication-disabled fixture skips login. Uses session cookies, not Basic/Bearer Auth; subsequent writes attach the returned CSRF header. Upload fixtures are relative to docs/postman. Coach and Athlete permissions are covered by the separate account-role collection.

Run every numbered folder in order from 00 - Authentication, one iteration. Generated fixture IDs are validated and saved automatically. Missing fixture values stop the run before an invalid URL is sent; failed fixture creation stops the run at its source. Role/authentication, CORS and CSRF rejection tests retain their expected negative responses.
